background_image_description: Subtle light-sage grid across the entire 1600x1600 canvas. Base is #d8e6cd with thin square gridlines in #c5d7bd spaced evenly (~160px), giving a calm notebook-like pattern.

nodes.svg_description: Large white rounded rectangle banner occupying the lower portion of the canvas with a gentle concave dip along the top edge centered under the jar area; smooth corners (~32px radius). Fill #ffffff, no stroke.
Flat oval shadow centered under the jar. Ellipse filled #93ad91 with soft edges (no stroke).

Hand-drawn glass jar with thick dark green outline (#2f4f46). White body (#ffffff) with subtle interior dark-green accent lines, short squiggle near the base, and lid area consisting of stacked rim lines. The jar has a warm yellow-orange lid/top fill (#f7c56d). Inside the jar are four doodle hearts with the same dark green outline: two red hearts (#d24b40) and two golden hearts (#f0b562), arranged diagonally.
Three short hand-drawn white dash marks suggesting sparkles, angled slightly, placed left of the jar. Strokes #ffffff, rounded caps.
Loose hand-drawn heart outline in white (#ffffff) with a single continuous stroke, placed at the upper-right near the headline.
Decorative number "1" with playful bubble style: fill #98b892, thick outline #2f4f46, small white dots (#ffffff) as highlights.
Decorative number "2" with the same bubble style as the 1: fill #98b892, thick outline #2f4f46, white highlight dots.

nodes.text: Write down your favorite self-care ideas on strips of paper.

nodes.svg_description: Decorative number "3" in matching bubble style: fill #98b892, thick outline #2f4f46, white highlight dots.

nodes.text: Whenever you're feeling down, stressed out, or drained – pull out a strip of paper and then do that activity.

nodes.svg_description: Hand-drawn brush underline stroke beneath the step 3 paragraph, slightly curved and tapering ends, fill #93ad91.
